hypothesis: The visible DeltaForge X-PRO signal recipe may retain positive executable value when its quote-relative heuristic, Phi blend, five-second cadence, informational Gate 1, 2% EV floor, 3-cent spread cap and 5bp directional confirmation are tested prospectively with honest fills and fees.

mechanism.signal: 60% Phi fair plus 40% quote-relative momentum/microstructure heuristic from the untouched purchased archive
mechanism.visible_settings: 5s cadence, Gate 1=0.45 informational, Gate 2=2%, Gate 3 strong-delta threshold=0.050%, maximum spread=3 cents
mechanism.safety_repairs: 45-second new-entry guard, one intent per market, executable depth, no midpoint or Gamma fills
mechanism.taker_arm: real ask, 250ms event-tape quote survival, <=20% displayed touch, 2x dynamic crypto taker fees plus one tick stress
mechanism.postonly_arm: one-tick-improved non-crossing bid, public-print queue depletion, partial fills and adverse-selection scoring
mechanism.sizing: $10 target from a frozen $500 paper bankroll; displayed capacity may reduce it
mechanism.exit: hold to terminal resolution; no interim mark-price stop

selection_disclosure: This experiment was created after forensic review of a promotional video and purchased code. The video PnL, all legacy MAIN trades, and all pre-manifest replays are excluded. The two execution arms are separate hypotheses and may not be pooled.
decision_rule: After at least 300 fresh independent markets and 14 calendar days per arm, require positive 2x-cost PnL in both chronological halves, market/day-clustered lower confidence bounds above zero, multiple-testing correction including every prior MAIN variant, non-negative 1/5/30-second adverse selection, and positive performance at 100/250/500ms. Otherwise reject the advertised edge.
zero_edge_disclosure: The expected and fully valid conclusion is that the quote-relative heuristic manufactures apparent EV and the executable edge is approximately zero or negative.
